author: cli
text: Re-read 2026-08-17, with fresh evidence rather than memory. 'An upgraded parser with a warm cache replayed stale edges forever; the cache is stamped with PARSE_SCHEMA_VERSION and discarded wholesale' was re-verified TODAY while scoping 0.56.0: patching the Python emitter to render dst_ref differently produced ['helper'] against a warm cache and ['helper/9'] after clearing it. The comment describes live behaviour, and that behaviour is why 0.56.0 must bump PARSE_SCHEMA_VERSION 6 -> 7 when the reference producer changes.
